V. 19.
But ye ſee me—That is ye ſhall certainly ſee me. Becauſe I live, ye ſhall live alſo. Be•••••
〈…〉 the living One in my divine Nature, and ſhall riſe again 〈…〉
••an Nature, and live for ever in Heaven; therefore ye ſh•••
•••e the Life of Faith and Love on Earth, and hereafter the Life of Glory.
